Reading guide: 'counts match paper' compares this independent scoring with the numbers the paper was built from. A company-level interval wider than the case-level one means the paper's case-level interval understates uncertainty from shared company records. The company-level bound is deliberately conservative (it allows every correct run of the worst company to be silent), so it is an upper envelope, not an estimate.
